policy_options.name: 逐样本人工语义证书
policy_options.mechanism: 具名内容审核者看完整生成原文、语境与适用R04来源，在新的获准审核任务中签发只覆盖该content_sha256的证书；宿主只绑定真实READ同字节样本。下一次改字/换语境失效。
policy_options.interaction: 生成后需要人审核才能推进语义里程碑；玩家动作/对话可先运行。
policy_options.ceiling: 适合首个真实canary可审阅样本，不等于实时任意表达的完整AI。
policy_options.new_authority_required: 审核者、证书来源/发行接口及具体样本采用，当前未指派。

policy_options.name: 采用具名语义判定器，歧义时确认
policy_options.mechanism: 判定器只提议语义，宿主核来源、完整内容、R04知识与实际READ。玩家意图歧义时用既有clarification请求明确含义/交流范围；如产品选择额外展示解释确认，玩家只确认本人表达意图，不能认证NPC诚实、外界事实或替NPC决定。清楚输入是否自动继续、哪些歧义必须确认，以及判定器误分型容忍均待采用。
policy_options.interaction: 原FP已允许上下文intent判断和必要澄清，不要求每句确认。新增显示语义解释/确认属于本候选UX取舍，非既有R04强制。
policy_options.ceiling: 保留自由表达和实时NPC潜力；机械守卫不能证明自然语言判定无误，尚无选定实现/校准/真实语义样本QA。
policy_options.new_authority_required: 具名判定器版本、信任/校准来源、错误处置、实测验收矩阵、确认交互范围及费用权限（若涉及新调用）。

policy_options.name: 生成语义仅作提议
policy_options.mechanism: 自由生成行动/话语仍按原FP和真实能力执行；具名READ形成本人HEARD_CLAIM。语义里程碑在无采用证书时OPEN，原AUTHORED_LOCAL独立保留，不能替生成路径命中。
policy_options.interaction: 不中断自由演出；明确未判定的关系推进，不能显示已解锁L1/L2/O2。
policy_options.ceiling: 安全的接缝前置/临时运行边界，未完成原实时自由AI剧情目标。
policy_options.new_authority_required: 若作为产品永久能力上限则需舰长接受；当前只说明机械缺依赖时的已有保守处理。

authority.model: PROPOSED ONLY; may interpret contextual intent and propose claims; no issuer or world authority
authority.player: May clarify/confirm own intended expression and requested communication scope only
authority.semantic_issuer: Unavailable until exact mechanism, issuer/version, scope and risk are adopted; JSON issuer strings are not capabilities
authority.channel_issuer: Existing trusted host presentation channel; actual recipient set and grant, never model/UI flag
authority.executor: Same existing executor; strict finite plan and real supported primitives only
authority.world_committer: Same sole original EventStore/committer; no new event types/root fields/proof extension
authority.story_projector: Derives E01/E02/E03/E04/E08 and L1/L2/O2 from original committed events plus admitted private join; no world writer

strict_wire.speech_payload_location: Existing FP speech.say parameters.text/audience_id; normal plan validation remains required
strict_wire.proposal_transport: Dedicated host-private in-memory adapter input or separately authorized private protocol; never extra fields in closed FP model_plan. Exact new runtime route is Coding scope, not supplied authority here.

mechanical_rules.require: Complete source-bound strict request/plan admission before speech; original input preserved, pilot max500 Unicode codepoints without truncation; no new model fields.

Three clocks are distinct: PRE_EXECUTION checks proposal against then-current active request/scene/actor/persona/knowledge/capabilities/cancel epoch. EVENT_TIME freezes original admitted plan, actual execution/event/READ and actual knowledge provenance as of utterance. LATE_INTERPRETATION checks certificate against that immutable event-time snapshot and presently authorized issuer/source capability, not against current request or advanced knowledge revision. No model JSON supplies authority; historical interpretation never authorizes fresh execution.

SHA256 over exact valid Unicode original text encoded UTF8, no trim/normalization. Codepoint half-open spans slice original exactly, end>start and within length. Whole text and context examined; substring cannot hide surrounding negation, quotation, condition, ambiguity or changed subject.

Certificate resolves through privately installed, presently eligible issuer and explicit adopted policy manifest/receipt. It binds exact original event-time source identities, proposal, context, content and event/READ. Current issuer suspension/revocation or missing original exact sources prevents admission. New request/cancel alone does not erase already completed valid speech. Hash/issuer strings, cloned JSON or debug objects cannot mint authority.

PRIVATE has explicit player scope and actual trusted single-recipient lin channel where E01 applies. PUBLIC has actual public grant and actual receivers; false/unavailable PRIVATE proof is UNRESOLVED, never PUBLIC. No geometric/voice privacy inference.

Original committed dialogue_presented event resolved by original trusted reader, 22-field schema/payload hash/identity/full sequence/CAS checked. Full actual READ delivered exact text to each required real bound recipient; range_start0/range_end=full_range_end=codepoint length; matching event, request/step/execution and receipt. DOM counter/target/model claims alone insufficient.

E01/E02/E03/E04/E08 retain exact R04 guards: E02 baseline+full disclosure+player READ independently of E01; L1 requires E01+E02. E03 accepts prior E02 knowledge OR an available legal trusted record; E03+E04 yields L2 independently of L1/E02. Actual prerequisite content and access predate relevant utterance; later certificates may verify earlier content but cannot create missing historical access. No belief/hearsay/selfreport becomes external verified record.

Clauses NO_MATCH/AMBIGUOUS/CONFLICT or incomplete context leave proposed semantics unadmitted. Semantic algorithm cannot be proved correct by structural guards; only selected empirical acceptance policy determines eligibility. Risk selection cannot override provenance/channel/cancel/world guards.

Before/during execution, new request/cancel/leave/unbind/source change invalidates remaining execution under original FP guards. Partial committed content remains partial; unseen ending cannot be certified as delivered. After valid complete original event/READ, later new request/cancel/current knowledge advancement does not retroactively revoke its historical meaning. Late admission cannot schedule old response or touch current execution; current issuer authority/source eligibility still mandatory.

Same causal projector consumes an atomic interpretation overlay, not a new world event or mutated receipt. Overlay commit covers per-actor effective knowledge, NPC fact filtering and Outcome views together at one semantic_projection_revision. Dedup by candidate/scene/original event+READ+meaning; outcome dedup by cause IDs+outcome. Same immutable identity with changed binding/content/meaning is CONFLICT, never last-write-wins.

Already observed semantic:null receipt remains immutable. A complete valid original event may gain a separately keyed verified interpretation overlay after dependency resolution. Actor context, NPC snapshot facts and Outcome must read the same published overlay revision; do not call observe again, duplicate memory or update Outcome alone. Causal dependencies are topologically evaluated by original event-time order, not certificate arrival; unresolved prerequisites are staged OPEN_DEPENDENCY. No original cursor/world version increment, receipt rewrite, speech replay, new request or stale NPC wake. Original exact trusted reader/source unavailable => OPEN_UNAVAILABLE.

Refresh audit/checksum-only restored reader remains UNVERIFIED_AUDIT; no restored serialized certificate/privacy flag revives runtime capability. Keep original UNKNOWN query identity, no model/physical replay. Reactivation requires actual same-source trusted reader not provided here.

interpretation_overlay.kind: Derived private semantic index; not world truth store
immutable_payload: guard dependencies and actual knowledge access refs
transaction_steps: Resolve original event/READ and immutable event-time snapshots using same trusted source reader; no re-execution
Validate selected policy/current issuer eligibility/exact content and temporal qualifications
Stage dependent certificates; evaluate original E02/record knowledge -> E03 -> E04 by event-time order; missing join evidence remains OPEN_DEPENDENCY
Build one projection diff: per-actor effective interpretation refs, NPC own fact view, outcome eligible histories; check current semantic_projection_revision CAS
Commit one semantic_projection_revision and publish all three views together; failure publishes none, retains staged evidence for review

Consumer snapshots capture one revision. Effective receipt = original immutable receipt + references to overlay meaning, not replacement of original receipt object; actor memories remain heard-claim, no duplicate observe/new raw memory entry
Do not automatically wake old-request NPC callbacks. Subsequent legitimate current actor requests may consume their own now-certified historical knowledge under current execution validation
interpretation_overlay.actor_visibility: Only actual historical receipt recipients receive observed meaning. Speaker may use own performed-speech evidence if original execution source grants that own-action observation; no inferred audience comprehension. Every NPC fact is filtered by that actor own baseline/actual observation or own-action provenance, never entire Outcome fact set.
interpretation_overlay.dependency_order: Certificate order irrelevant; actual content/access ordering must satisfy R04. Certificate arriving after E03 may verify prior E02 READ, not create previously missing player access. Trusted-record route requires actual adopted reader/access existing before E03, not a record minted afterwards.
interpretation_overlay.idempotence: Identical already-admitted semantic joins no new projection revision/memory/outcome or world event. Same join semantic payload conflict rejects transaction; multiple independently valid corroborating certificates may add audit references without rewriting original meaning or duplicate outcomes.

trusted record authority/adoption receipt independent from semantic classifier
